title: Ind AS 12 / ASC 740 Deferred Tax Asset & Liability Reconciliation Schedule
description: Calculates temporary differences, closing DTA and DTL balances, P&L tax expense, and Effective Tax Rate (ETR) reconciliation.

accountingProfitBeforeTaxInr.description: Profit before tax per Statement of Profit and Loss

enactedTaxRatePercent.description: Applicable statutory corporate tax rate including surcharge and cess (e.g. 25.168% for Sec 115BAA)

permanentDifferencesInr.description: Permanent non-deductible expenses (e.g., penalties, CSR expenditure u/s 37(1))
